about_the_game:
Your kingdom has tasked you with an impossible task, pioneering the dark forest. A place shaped by shifting tiles and ever-growing danger, here your settlement is both a sanctuary and a weapon.

This is a game where tactical turn based gameplay meets relentless tower defense. You begin with a fragile spark of civilization and from there, you must grow, defend, and adapt. The landscape isn’t just a backdrop, it's a puzzle. Every district you place changes how your city functions, and every path you lay guides both your people and your enemies.

At the heart of it all is balance: between expansion and defense, between resource gathering and survival. You'll make hard choices as waves of enemies pressure your every decision. Build smarter, connect deeper, and push your strategies to the edge. One misstep could mean the fall of your entire city, but with the right approach your settlement will become an unbreakable stronghold!

Key Features

  • Strategically planning your defense

  • Roguelike upgrades to districts

  • Survive through an endless onslaught of enemies

  • Dynamic enemy pathfinding

  • Experience randomly generated runs with high replayability

  • Persistent universal upgrades

short_description: Defense Collapse is a strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Pioneer the unexplored dark forest, build your town and defenses, and hold out against the massive hordes of enemies. How long can you survive?
